text:
maria: Quick note — I opened PR #4827 to migrate the quickstart from REST/curl to SDK v2. Changes: new npm package, API key auth by default, updated env var names, and rewritten deploy steps. Preview: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4827

sasha: Nice. I'll check the auth section. Are we dropping the oauth flow entirely from the quickstart or keeping it as an advanced note?

maria: Keeping oauth as an advanced section but not in the 5-min path. Quickstart should use API keys to reduce friction. I renamed REDWOOD_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_KEY across snippets — please watch for any missed references.

liam: I can run the sample app locally and smoke-test the deploy steps. Which branch?

maria: docs/quickstart/sdk-v2 on my fork — link in the PR. Also swapped the client import (was @redwood/client in older docs) to @redwood/sdk. Snippet in PR: 
```js
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const resp = await client.generate('hello world')
```

olivia: Heads-up: onboarding email links to the old quickstart URL. I can update the campaign once you confirm final published path.

sasha: Found one broken sidebar link to /docs/auth-setup in the TOC; PR includes a fix. Also suggest adding a short note: "If you're on free tier, 2FA is optional" under account setup.

liam: Ran the app and saw a minor Docker env mismatch — Dockerfile still sets ENV REDWOOD_API_KEY. Pushed a tiny commit to the branch to change it to REDWOOD_KEY. Test logs: 
```
> docker build .
> ENV REDWOOD_KEY set
> npm start
Server listening 0.0.0.0:3000
API key validated
```

deploy-bot: Preview deploy ready: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference.com/pr/4827 

maria: Awesome, thanks. @sasha can you review the auth snippet and TOC change? @liam can you sign off on the preview? @olivia I'll ping you when we have the final URL to update the onboarding email. Targeting merge EOD Friday. :thumbsup:

sasha: On it — will leave inline comments on the PR in next hour.

liam: Preview looks good for me, verified env fix and sample output. Signed off.

olivia: Cool, hold on the email change until you merge and give me the canonical URL.

maria: Great sync, thanks everyone. Will squash & prepare CHANGELOG entry after approvals.
